name: Blast radius of a symbol
description: Every symbol that reaches a given symbol through resolved calls, directly or indirectly, with the shortest call depth (up to 6). Calls include callback references, where a function is passed to another call such as asyncio.to_thread(f, x). Replace the target name to analyse another symbol; tests are included so the affected tests are listed too.
sql:
WITH RECURSIVE impact(symbol_id, depth) AS (
  SELECT c.caller_symbol_id, 1
  FROM code.calls c
  JOIN code.symbols t ON t.symbol_id = c.callee_symbol_id
  WHERE t.name = 'resolve_semantic_fks'
  UNION
  SELECT c.caller_symbol_id, i.depth + 1
  FROM code.calls c
  JOIN impact i ON c.callee_symbol_id = i.symbol_id
  WHERE i.depth < 6
)
SELECT i.symbol_id, s.file_id, f.is_test, MIN(i.depth) AS depth
FROM impact i
JOIN code.symbols s ON s.symbol_id = i.symbol_id
JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = s.file_id
GROUP BY i.symbol_id, s.file_id, f.is_test
ORDER BY depth, i.symbol_id

name: Untested public API
description: Public functions, methods and classes in non-test files that no test file links to, by import or by file name. Static links only: a test that reaches the file indirectly is not counted.
sql:
SELECT u.file_id, u.symbol_id, u.kind
FROM code.untested_public_symbols u
ORDER BY u.file_id, u.symbol_id

name: Most-called functions
description: Symbols outside the tests ranked by the number of resolved direct call sites that target them, with the number of callback references (the symbol passed by reference to another call) and of distinct callers. Unresolved calls are not counted.
sql:
SELECT v.symbol_id, v.kind, v.inbound_calls, v.callback_references, v.distinct_callers
FROM code.inbound_call_counts v
JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = v.file_id
WHERE NOT f.is_test AND v.inbound_calls > 0
ORDER BY v.inbound_calls DESC, v.symbol_id
LIMIT 50

name: Undocumented modules
description: Non-test Python files whose module docstring is missing, so their description is empty and its source is none.
sql:
SELECT file_id, module, line_count
FROM code.files
WHERE description_source = 'none' AND NOT is_test
ORDER BY line_count DESC, file_id

name: Package documentation coverage
description: Per package, the number of non-test files and the share whose module docstring gives a description.
sql:
SELECT package,
       COUNT(*) AS files,
       SUM(CASE WHEN description_source <> 'none' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS described,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN description_source <> 'none' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_described
FROM code.files
WHERE NOT is_test
GROUP BY package
ORDER BY package

name: Import fan-in by file
description: Non-test files ranked by how many other files import them; a change to a file near the top touches the most importers.
sql:
SELECT i.imported_file_id AS file_id, COUNT(DISTINCT i.file_id) AS importers
FROM code.imports i
JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = i.imported_file_id
WHERE NOT f.is_test AND i.file_id <> i.imported_file_id
GROUP BY i.imported_file_id
ORDER BY importers DESC, file_id
LIMIT 50

name: Unresolved call names
description: Callee names most often left unresolved outside the tests: calls that are not internal, not a builtin, not rooted in an external import and not a method on an untyped object (callbacks, parameters, local callables). A guide to where the call graph is genuinely incomplete.
sql:
SELECT c.callee_name, COUNT(*) AS call_sites
FROM code.calls c
JOIN code.symbols s ON s.symbol_id = c.caller_symbol_id
JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = s.file_id
WHERE c.resolution = 'unresolved' AND NOT f.is_test
GROUP BY c.callee_name
ORDER BY call_sites DESC, c.callee_name
LIMIT 50
